conviction_note: The quarter was pre-released in full on 2026-11-13 (ESPI 81/2026: segment EBITDA, one-offs, net profit, volumes, prices, capex, net cash and economic net debt) and the stock has already reacted (-2.18% on 11-16). The only new line is a probable first qualitative 2027 segment outlook at the results presentation, as PGE gave for 2026 at its Q3 2025 presentation. Public inputs lean mildly positive for coal (2027 capacity contracts, a higher BASE_Y-27 forward) but this rests on inference, so p_up is 52 on an abs_move of 3.3 (the pre-released base nudged up for a likely first guide), giving +0.13. The findings sum to +0.4 because the guidance finding is sized on its own. The two measurements agree in sign and differ in scale by design.

findings.finding: The release or its next-day presentation will probably carry PGE's first 2027 segment outlook (it gave the 2026 one at the Q3 2025 presentation). Public inputs tilt the coal segment's 2027 direction up: PGE units won at least 1,859 MW of 2027 capacity contracts at 325.55-372.04 PLN/kW/yr, and the BASE_Y-27 forward averaged 495.52 PLN/MWh in Aug 2026 against 419 a year earlier. Gas hedges for later years and an election-year tariff squeeze push the other way.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026 segment outlook came with the Q3 2025 report and presentation (released 2025-11-25 evening, presented 11-26). PGE.WA closed +1.84% on 2025-11-26 (Yahoo daily closes). Strategy update day 2026-10-20/21: +3.77% and +4.33%.
findings.original_quote: PGE zakłada w 2026 r. spadek rok do roku powtarzalnej EBITDA w energetyce węglowej, energetyce odnawialnej i w obrocie – poinformowała spółka w prezentacji wynikowej. [translation: PGE expects a y/y decline in recurring EBITDA in coal, renewables and trading in 2026, the company said in its results presentation.] Second source (money.pl, 2026-09-03): 'jednostki należące do Grupy PGE uzyskały kontrakty mocowe o łącznym obowiązku mocowym niemniejszym niż 1 859 MW' [PGE Group units won capacity contracts totalling no less than 1,859 MW]. Third source (Parkiet, 2026-09-07): 'Średnia ważona cena kontraktu rocznego w roku 2027 (BASE_Y-27) wyniosła w sierpniu 2026 r. 495,52 zł/MWh' [the weighted average price of the 2027 annual contract was 495.52 PLN/MWh in August 2026].
findings.why_not_priced: Each input is public, but no 2027 company outlook exists yet, so the market cannot price PGE's own mapping of these inputs into segment directions. Had it been priced, the stock would not have fallen 2.2% on 11-16 and a further 4.3% on 11-20 with no company news. Only partly unpriced: the October strategy already set a trajectory, so this is small and inference-based.
findings.independence: Two different sources for the inputs: the capacity auction ESPI (https://www.money.pl/gielda/komunikaty/7325499229397569.html) and TGE forward prices via Parkiet (https://www.parkiet.com/energetyka/art45107471-pge-moze-na-krotko-skorzystac-z-drozejacego-gazu-co-pozniej). The same Parkiet article names the counter-risk ('Problemem będą kontrakty na kolejne lata', i.e. gas contracts for later years are the problem).

findings.finding: Recurring EBITDA of 2.89bn includes a non-cash -0.54bn accounting valuation of electricity contracts booked in 'Other activity'. Excluding it, the underlying run-rate is ~3.43bn against the 3.2bn PAP consensus. The full report will itemise it, but it is already in the prelim.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the prelims (2026-11-16) the market sold the one-off-driven headline beat (-2.18%). On full-report days after a prelim the stock moved +1.84% (2025-11-26), -0.05% (2026-05-27) and -0.75% (2026-09-16).
findings.original_quote: Pozostała Działalność i korekty konsolidacyjne: -0,48 mld PLN (w tym efekt księgowej wyceny kontraktów związanych z energią elektryczną w kwocie -0,54 mld PLN). [translation: Other activity and consolidation adjustments: -0.48bn PLN, including an accounting valuation effect on electricity-related contracts of -0.54bn PLN.]
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: it sat in the 13 Nov ESPI that the market traded on. It is filed at 0 because the full report can only restate it. Press coverage (Rankia, Strefa) led with recurring 2.89bn as 'below last year' and did not mention the -0.54bn, so a sell-side reframing at the presentation is possible but unsourced.

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is +0.29 (the -5.83% 20-day run-up, i.e. the free control). The small positive guidance lean agrees with it in sign, so it adds little that is orthogonal. Most of the 20-day drop came after the strategy peak and the prelims, which the findings do not explain.

English searches returned last year's PAP English headline only.

lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the -0.54bn contract-valuation finding went from +0.1 to 0.0, because it sits in the 13 Nov prelim.

'The move is in the guide / a first guide for a new fiscal year is a scheduled guidance event': the 2027-outlook finding went from +0.3 to +0.4 (guidance scale, held small because it rests on inference), and abs_move_pct went from 3.0 to 3.3.
Session lesson (Adocia/Philogen/VIGO): session_check opens with 'amc' and cites timestamps; this had already been settled in the hunt.
